description: Explicit mapping from MIT-BIH annotation symbols to AAMI EC57 heartbeat classes. Symbols not listed under 'classes' are not beats (or are excluded) and never become training examples.

symbols.F: Fusion of ventricular and normal beat

symbols.f: Fusion of paced and normal beat

non_beat_symbols.x: Non-conducted P wave (blocked APB) - no QRS, not a heartbeat segment
non_beat_symbols.!: Ventricular flutter wave - excluded per AAMI EC57 (some papers map it to V; we do not)
non_beat_symbols.B: Bundle branch block beat (unspecified) - not present in MIT-BIH
non_beat_symbols.n: Supraventricular escape beat - not present in MIT-BIH
non_beat_symbols.r: R-on-T PVC - not present in MIT-BIH
non_beat_symbols.?: Beat not classified during learning - not present in MIT-BIH

paced_records_note: Excluded from training and evaluation following the AAMI EC57 recommendation and de Chazal et al. (2004). They remain browsable in the application.
q_class_note: After removing paced records only a handful of Q beats remain, far too few to learn or score. Q beats are counted and displayed but excluded from the principal 4-class experiment. A 5-class mode is selectable.
